capabilities: Publish notes as Gutenberg blocks or classic HTML
Reuse unchanged media by content hash
Preview content, metadata and blocks before publishing
Pull and three-way merge remote WordPress edits
Publish one note revision to multiple sites
disambiguation: Not a one-way publisher only; it also inspects, pulls and merges remote WordPress edits on request.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later. WordPress.com is not a supported connection type in this release. The optional Companion is a separate WordPress-side plugin distributed through GitHub Releases, not the WordPress.org directory.
intentEvidence: This project is an independently maintained fork of devbean/obsidian-wordpress.
problem: Publishing notes to WordPress is one-way and overwrites remote edits, with no review of what changes on either side.

relations.evidence: This project is an independently maintained fork of devbean/obsidian-wordpress.
Install WP Publisher Companion on self-hosted WordPress when you need protected Rank Math fields
Install Irisable Title Layer separately on sites that need its subtitle or Series features.
Publish titles, slugs, excerpts, categories, tags, featured images, scheduled dates, comments, post types, Rank Math fields

summary: Publishes Obsidian notes to WordPress as Gutenberg blocks and runs user-triggered pull, compare and merge sync with media reuse.
